name: Litter on a Forest Walk (Menzel et al. 2024): video restoration experiment
description:
Faithful replication of Study 2 of Menzel, von der Heiden, Tretau & Wissel (2024), "Wasting the restorative potential: Influences of plastic and biowaste on psychological restoration after real, virtual, and imagined walks", Global Environmental Psychology (doi:10.5964/gep.11463). Uses the authors' own three videos of the same forest walk from OSF vkp85 (osf.io/vkp85): no waste, biowaste, or plastic waste along the path. The OSF project gives no licence; the videos are used with credit and the template will be taken down if the authors object.

What participants do: consent; state connectedness to nature (13 items, 1–5) and PANAS (20 adjectives, 1–5); random assignment to one 4.6-minute video (starts with a click, no skipping forward, Continue only at the end); connectedness and PANAS again; Restoration Outcome Scale (6 items, 1–7); scene preference (attractive / like / would visit for a restorative walk, 1–5); describe the video in at least 5 words; litter manipulation check ("Did you see any litter? What kind?" or "I did not see any litter"); plastic problem awareness (8 items + attention item "please tick 'rather big problem'", 1–5); plastic-avoidance purchase intentions (3 items, 1–5); support for 10 plastic policies (1–7); video checks (watched the whole video attentively / screen ≥ 12 inches), technical problems; gender, age, country, education, occupation, conscientious answering, data use.

Data: matrix rows are keyed by the original SoSci item numbers (ctn_pre = C101_xx, panas_pre = P101_xx, ctn_post = C201, panas_post = P201, ros = R101, preference = PR01, problem = PB01, intention = PI01, policy = PP01, checks = KF03), so the authors' R script (OSF) maps directly. walk.condition = none / bio / plastic (ST01 1/2/3). Analysis as in the paper: exclude people who answered no to either video check, did not answer conscientiously, failed the attention item (PB01_09 ≠ 4) or reported litter in the no-waste video; then one-way ANOVAs across the three conditions on restoration (ROS mean), pre–post change in positive affect, negative affect and connectedness, each preference item, problem awareness, intentions and policy support.

Differences from the original study: (1) the German SoSci Survey questionnaire is translated into English by us from the German items (PANAS adjectives given as their usual English equivalents); (2) conditions are drawn at random per participant instead of SoSci's balanced urn; (3) videos are re-encoded from 1920×1080 to 1280×720 and served by the platform instead of Panopto; (4) items within each scale are shown in random order; (5) country is typed instead of chosen from a list; (6) the prize draw / course-credit e-mail, SurveyCircle code and the "really delete?" follow-up are left out and the GDPR consent text is shortened; (7) small screens get a warning instead of being excluded at the start. Study 1 (real walks) and Study 3 (imagined walk) are not included.
author: Menzel, von der Heiden, Tretau & Wissel

elements.name: consent
elements.title: I confirm that I am at least 18 years old, that I have understood the information about this study and that I agree to take part.

elements.name: ctn_pre

rows.text: Right now I feel at one with the nature around me.
At the moment I experience nature as a community to which I belong.
Currently I recognise and appreciate the perfection of other living organisms.
Right now I feel estranged from nature.
When I think about my life now, I see myself as part of a larger natural cycle of life.
Currently I feel a kinship with animals and plants.
Right now I feel that I belong to the Earth just as much as the Earth belongs to me.
At the moment I have a deep understanding of how my actions affect the natural environment.
Right now I feel part of nature.
At this moment I feel that all human and non-human living beings on Earth share a common “life energy”.
Like a tree as part of a forest, I now feel embedded in a larger natural whole.
Right now I see myself as a small part of the natural world around me, no more important than the grass on the meadow or a bird in the trees.
My current personal well-being depends on the well-being of nature.

elements.title: Please indicate how much you agree with each of the following statements. Consider your feelings and experiences at this moment. There are no right or wrong answers.
elements.description: State connectedness to nature, 13 items, 1–5 (C101_01–13 in the open data; item 04 is reverse-scored).

elements.name: panas_pre
elements.title: The following words describe different feelings and sensations. Please indicate how you feel at the moment.
elements.description: PANAS, 20 adjectives, 1–5 (P101_01–20). Positive affect = 01 03 04 06 10 11 13 15 17 18; negative affect = 02 05 07 08 09 12 14 16 19 20.

elements.name: walk

elements.description: { condition: 'none' | 'bio' | 'plastic', watched_s, pauses, completed } — random assignment as ST01 in the open data (1 = no waste, 2 = biowaste, 3 = plastic waste). The 4.6-minute video starts with a click, cannot be skipped forward, and Continue appears when it has ended.

elements.name: ros

rows.text: I get new enthusiasm and new energy for my everyday life.
My concentration and attention are noticeably increased.
I can forget the worries of everyday life.
Watching the video helped me to clear my head and sort out my thoughts.

elements.title: How do you feel after watching the video?
elements.description: Restoration Outcome Scale, 6 items, 1–7 (R101_01–06); mean = subjective restoration, the main outcome.

elements.name: preference

rows.text: It is likely that I would visit a place like this for a restorative walk.

elements.title: You have just watched a video. How would you rate the environment shown?
elements.description: Scene preference, 1–5 (PR01_01 attractive, PR01_02 like, PR01_04 would visit for a restorative walk), each compared between conditions.

elements.name: describe
elements.title: Please describe in keywords, in at least 5 words, what you saw. What was shown in the video?

elements.name: litter
elements.title: Did you see any litter? If so, what kind of litter did you see?
elements.description: { none: true | false, text } — manipulation check KF02 (KF02_01a = “I did not see any litter”). The authors excluded no-waste participants who reported litter.

elements.name: problem

rows.text: Aesthetic burden from plastic waste in the environment
Energy and resource consumption of plastic production
Species extinction caused by plastic waste in the environment
Social inequalities in plastic production and disposal

elements.title: Do you see the following aspects as a very big problem, a rather big problem, a rather small problem or no problem?
elements.description: Plastic problem awareness, 8 items, 1–5 (PB01). Row 09 is the attention check: keep only answers of 4 (“rather big problem”).

elements.name: intention

rows.text: … not to buy fruit or vegetables wrapped in plastic.
… to buy chilled products (e.g., milk, yoghurt) in glass instead of plastic packaging, even if they are more expensive.
… to have food filled into containers or bags I bring myself.

elements.title: How do you rate the following statements? “When I think about my next shopping trips, I plan …”
elements.description: Plastic-avoidance purchase intentions, 3 items, 1–5 (PI01).

elements.name: policy

rows.text: Ban on plastic packaging for fruit and vegetables
A label that marks microplastic-free ingredients
Ban on excessive packaging material that does not protect the product
For single-use packaging, a ban on composite materials (plastic combined with other materials) that cannot be recycled
Obligation for restaurants, snack bars and coffee-to-go outlets to accept customers’ own containers
Extend the deposit on all single-use plastic drink bottles
Higher fines for people or companies who deliberately or negligently release plastic waste into the environment
Redistribution of public funds towards cleaning plastic waste out of the environment

elements.title: Are you generally against or in favour of the following policy measures to reduce plastic consumption and waste? Please consider what these measures would mean for your own life.
elements.description: Support for plastic policies, 10 items, 1–7 (PP01).

elements.name: checks

rows.text: Did you watch the whole video attentively?
Did you take part on a device with a large screen (at least 12 inches)?

elements.title: The following questions are about the video. Please answer truthfully; your answer has no consequences for you but matters for the analysis.
elements.description: 1 = no, 2 = yes (KF03). The authors excluded people who answered no to either question.

elements.name: tech
elements.title: Did any technical problems occur while you watched the video?
elements.description: KF04: 1 = yes, 2 = no.

elements.name: tech_detail
elements.title: If yes, please describe the problems.

elements.name: gender
elements.title: What is your gender?
elements.description: SD01.

elements.name: age
elements.title: How old are you (in years)?

elements.name: country
elements.title: In which country do you currently live?
elements.description: SD08 (a country list in the original).

elements.name: education
elements.title: What is your highest educational qualification?

choices.text: Intermediate school leaving certificate (Realschulabschluss / Mittlere Reife)
Entrance qualification for universities of applied sciences (Fachhochschulreife)
General or subject-specific university entrance qualification (Abitur)

elements.description: SD10, German school system; codes as in the open data.

elements.name: education_other
elements.title: Other qualification:

elements.name: occupation
elements.title: What is your occupation?
elements.description: SD14.

elements.name: occupation_detail
elements.title: If student: what do you study? If other: what do you do?

elements.name: serious
elements.title: Did you fill in the questionnaire conscientiously? Your answer has no disadvantages for you; it is important for the analysis.
elements.description: KF07: 1 = yes, 2 = no. The authors kept only “yes”.

elements.name: data_use
elements.title: The data set is anonymous, so your data cannot be deleted individually later. You can now say whether your data may be used or should be deleted.
elements.description: IN08: 1 = keep, 2 = delete. Drop rows with 2 before analysis.

<style>
:root{--bg:#f2f4f0;--card:#fff;--ink:#1d211c;--muted:#59615a;--accent:#2f6b45;--accent-ink:#fff;--line:#d4dad3;--warn:#b3261e}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
main{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 16px 40px}
h1{font-size:1.4rem;margin:0 0 10px}p{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 20px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.q{margin-top:18px}.q:first-child{margin-top:0}.q>b{display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
label.opt{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer}
input[type=number],input[type=text]{font:inherit;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;width:100%;max-width:340px}
input[type=number]{max-width:120px}
textarea{width:100%;font:inherit;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;min-height:80px}
.vid{position:relative;background:#000;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/9}
.vid video{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
#ov{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:12px}
#ov button{font-size:1.1rem}
.bar{height:6px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin:10px 0 6px}.bar>i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent);width:0}
.ctl{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.ctl .t{color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.item{padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.item:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.item>b{display:block;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}
.sc{display:grid;gap:4px}
.sc button{appearance:none;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 0;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;min-width:0}
.sc button.on{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
.legend{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0 0}
.note{background:#fff7e0;border:1px solid #e9d48a;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;color:#5b4a10;font-size:.9rem}
.err{color:var(--warn);margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.credit{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}
</style>

Your data are collected anonymously.</p><label class="opt"><input type="checkbox" id="ok"> '+esc(Q.consent.title)+'</label><div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" id="go">Start</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){
      if(!document.getElementById('ok').checked)return err('Consent is needed to continue.');
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;saveAll([['consent',true]],b,function(){ans.intro=true;next();});
    };
  }
  function block(name){
    var B=BLOCKS[name], lab=B.labels, vals={}, rows=shuffle(B.rows), n=lab.length;
    var leg=lab.map(function(t,k){return t?(k+1)+' = '+esc(t):'';}).filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    app.innerHTML=head()+'<div class="card"><b>'+esc(B.title)+'</b><p class="legend">'+leg+'</p>'+
      rows.map(function(r){var b='';for(var v=1;v<=n;v++)b+='<button type="button" data-r="'+esc(r.value)+'" data-v="'+v+'" title="'+esc(lab[v-1]||String(v))+'">'+(n===2?esc(lab[v-1]):v)+'</button>';return '<div class="item"><b>'+esc(r.text)+'</b><div class="sc" style="grid-template-columns:repeat('+n+',1fr)">'+b+'</div></div>';}).join('')+
      (name==='checks'?'<div class="item"><b>'+esc(Q.tech.title)+'</b><label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="tech" value="1"> Yes</label><label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="tech" value="2"> No</label><div id="td" style="display:none;margin-top:8px"><textarea id="tdx" placeholder="'+esc(Q.tech_detail.title)+'"></textarea></div></div>':'')+
      '<div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" id="go">Continue</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    app.querySelectorAll('.sc button').forEach(function(x){x.onclick=function(){vals[x.dataset.r]=Number(x.dataset.v);x.parentNode.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(y){y.classList.toggle('on',y===x);});err('');};});
    app.querySelectorAll('input[name=tech]').forEach(function(x){x.onchange=function(){document.getElementById('td').style.display=x.value==='1'?'block':'none';};});
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){
      var miss=B.rows.filter(function(r){return vals[r.value]==null;});if(miss.length)return err('Please answer every statement ('+miss.length+' left).');
      var o={};B.rows.forEach(function(r){o[r.value]=vals[r.value];});var list=[[name,o]];
      if(name==='checks'){var t=app.querySelector('input[name=tech]:checked');if(!t)return err('Please say whether technical problems occurred.');list.push(['tech',Number(t.value)]);var d=document.getElementById('tdx').value.trim();if(t.value==='1'){if(!d)return err('Please describe the problems.');list.push(['tech_detail',d]);}}
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;saveAll(list,b,function(){ans[name]=true;next();});
    };
  }
  function walkIntro(){
    app.innerHTML=head()+'<div class="card"><p style="color:var(--ink)">You will now see a short video. Please watch it attentively and try to imagine yourself in the situation as well as you can.</p><p>The video does not start by itself: click the play button to start it. Please keep the sound on.</p><button class="btn" id="go">Continue</button></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){ans.walkIntro=true;next();};
  }
  function fmt(s){s=Math.max(0,Math.floor(s));return Math.floor(s/60)+':'+('0'+s%60).slice(-2);}
  function player(){
    var MAX=window.__VIDMAX||0;
    app.innerHTML=head()+'<div class="vid"><video playsinline preload="auto"></video><div id="ov"><button class="btn" id="play">▶ Play video</button></div></div><div class="bar"><i></i></div><div class="ctl"><button class="btn ghost" id="pp" disabled>Pause</button><span class="t" id="tt">0:00</span></div><div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" id="nx" disabled>Continue</button></div><div class="err"></div>';
    var v=app.querySelector('video'), played=0, last=null, pauses=0, done=false, ov=document.getElementById('ov'), pp=document.getElementById('pp');
    v.src=files[cond+'.mp4'].url;
    function dur(){return MAX||v.duration||277;}
    function end(){if(done)return;done=true;v.pause();pp.disabled=true;document.getElementById('nx').disabled=false;ov.style.display='flex';ov.textContent='The video has ended. Please continue.';}
    v.addEventListener('timeupdate',function(){if(last!=null&&!v.paused){var d=v.currentTime-last;if(d>0&&d<2)played+=d;}last=v.currentTime;var el=Math.min(v.currentTime,dur());document.getElementById('tt').textContent=fmt(el)+' / '+fmt(dur());app.querySelector('.bar>i').style.width=(100*el/dur())+'%';if(MAX&&v.currentTime>=MAX)end();});
    v.addEventListener('ended',end);
    v.addEventListener('seeking',function(){if(last!=null&&v.currentTime-last>1.5)v.currentTime=last;});
    v.addEventListener('playing',function(){ov.style.display='none';});
    v.addEventListener('waiting',function(){if(!done){ov.style.display='flex';ov.textContent='Loading…';}});
    function start(){v.play().then(function(){pp.disabled=false;}).catch(function(){ov.style.display='flex';});}
    document.getElementById('play').onclick=start;
    ov.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(!done&&e.target===ov)start();});
    pp.onclick=function(){if(v.paused){v.play();pp.textContent='Pause';}else{v.pause();pauses++;pp.textContent='Play';}};
    document.getElementById('nx').onclick=function(){
      if(!done)return;var b=this;b.disabled=true;
      SPSite.answer('walk',{condition:cond,watched_s:Math.round(played),pauses:pauses,completed:true}).then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){b.disabled=false;return err(r.error);}ans.walk=true;next();});
    };
  }
  function words(t){return t.split(/[\s,;.\/]+/).filter(Boolean).length;}
  function describe(){
    app.innerHTML=head()+'<div class="card"><b>'+esc(Q.describe.title)+'</b><textarea id="tx" style="margin-top:8px"></textarea><div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" id="go">Continue</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){var t=document.getElementById('tx').value.trim();if(words(t)<5)return err('Please use at least 5 words.');var b=this;b.disabled=true;saveAll([['describe',t]],b,function(){ans.describe=true;next();});};
  }
  function litter(){
    app.innerHTML=head()+'<div class="card"><b>'+esc(Q.litter.title)+'</b><textarea id="tx" style="margin-top:8px" placeholder="Kind of litter"></textarea><label class="opt"><input type="checkbox" id="none"> I did not see any litter</label><div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" id="go">Continue</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    var tx=document.getElementById('tx'), no=document.getElementById('none');
    no.onchange=function(){tx.disabled=no.checked;err('');};
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){var t=tx.value.trim();if(!no.checked&&!t)return err('Please describe the litter, or tick “I did not see any litter”.');var b=this;b.disabled=true;saveAll([['litter',{none:no.checked,text:no.checked?'':t}]],b,function(){ans.litter=true;next();});};
  }
  function radios(name){return (Q[name].choices||[]).map(function(c){return '<label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="'+name+'" value="'+esc(c.value)+'"> '+esc(c.text)+'</label>';}).join('');}
  function about(){
    app.innerHTML=head()+'<div class="card"><p>Finally, please answer a few general questions.</p>'+
      '<div class="q"><b>'+esc(Q.gender.title)+'</b>'+radios('gender')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="q"><b>'+esc(Q.age.title)+'</b><input type="number" id="age" min="18" max="100" inputmode="numeric"></div>'+
      '<div class="q"><b>'+esc(Q.country.title)+'</b><input type="text" id="country" autocomplete="country-name"></div>'+
      '<div class="q"><b>'+esc(Q.education.title)+'</b>'+radios('education')+'<input type="text" id="eduo" style="margin-top:6px;display:none" placeholder="'+esc(Q.education_other.title)+'"></div>'+
      '<div class="q"><b>'+esc(Q.occupation.title)+'</b>'+radios('occupation')+'<input type="text" id="occd" style="margin-top:6px;display:none" placeholder=""></div>'+
      '<div class="q"><b>'+esc(Q.serious.title)+'</b>'+radios('serious')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="q"><b>'+esc(Q.data_use.title)+'</b>'+radios('data_use')+'</div>'+
      '<div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" id="go">Finish</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    function val(n){var x=app.querySelector('input[name='+n+']:checked');return x?Number(x.value):null;}
    app.querySelectorAll('input[name=education]').forEach(function(x){x.onchange=function(){document.getElementById('eduo').style.display=x.value==='9'?'block':'none';};});
    app.querySelectorAll('input[name=occupation]').forEach(function(x){x.onchange=function(){var d=document.getElementById('occd');d.style.display=(x.value==='3'||x.value==='8')?'block':'none';d.placeholder=x.value==='3'?'What do you study?':'What do you do?';};});
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){
      var g=val('gender');if(!g)return err('Please select your gender.');
      var av=document.getElementById('age').value,age=Number(av);if(!av||!(age>=18&&age<=100))return err('Please enter your age (18–100).');
      var c=document.getElementById('country').value.trim();if(!c)return err('Please enter the country you live in.');
      var e=val('education');if(!e)return err('Please select your highest qualification.');
      var o=val('occupation');if(!o)return err('Please select your occupation.');
      var s=val('serious');if(!s)return err('Please say whether you filled in the questionnaire conscientiously.');
      var d=val('data_use');if(!d)return err('Please say whether your data may be stored.');
      var list=[['gender',g],['age',age],['country',c],['education',e],['occupation',o],['serious',s],['data_use',d]];
      var eo=document.getElementById('eduo').value.trim();if(e===9&&eo)list.push(['education_other',eo]);
      var od=document.getElementById('occd').value.trim();if((o===3||o===8)&&od)list.push(['occupation_detail',od]);
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;saveAll(list,b,function(){ans.about=true;next();});
    };
  }
  function finish(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Thank you for taking part!</h1><div class="card"><p>This study looked at how you perceived your virtual walk and how it affected how you feel right now. In particular, it looks at how litter influences the perception and effect of such a walk, and how this relates to attitudes towards the environment and towards plastic. You were randomly shown one of three versions of the same forest walk: without litter, with biowaste, or with plastic waste. Please keep this to yourself for now so that other participants are not influenced.</p><p style="font-size:.82rem">Videos: Study 2 stimuli of Menzel, von der Heiden, Tretau & Wissel (2024), Global Environmental Psychology, doi:10.5964/gep.11463, OSF vkp85. Used with credit and removed if the authors object.</p><p id="fin">Submitting…</p><div class="err"></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){err(r.error||'Some answers are missing.');var m=r.missing||[];setTimeout(function(){m.forEach(function(x){
      if(x==='consent')ans.intro=false;else if(x==='walk'){ans.walk=false;ans.walkIntro=false;}else if(x==='tech'||x==='tech_detail')ans.checks=false;
      else if(['gender','age','country','education','education_other','occupation','occupation_detail','serious','data_use'].indexOf(x)>=0)ans.about=false;else ans[x]=false;});next();},1800);}
      else{var s=document.getElementById('fin');if(s)s.textContent='Your answers have been saved. You can close this window now.';}});
  }
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){
    ['consent','walk','describe','litter','tech','tech_detail','gender','age','country','education','education_other','occupation','occupation_detail','serious','data_use'].forEach(function(n){Q[n]=SPSite.getQuestion(n)||{};});
    (SPSite.getMedia('videos')||[]).forEach(function(f){files[f.name]=f;});
    var a=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};
    var c=(a.walk&&a.walk.condition)||load('cond');if(CONDS.indexOf(c)<0)c=CONDS[Math.floor(Math.random()*3)];cond=c;save('cond',cond);
    if(a.consent===true){ans.intro=true;
      ['ctn_pre','panas_pre','ctn_post','panas_post','ros','preference','describe','litter','problem','intention','policy'].forEach(function(k){if(a[k]!=null)ans[k]=true;});
      if(a.walk&&a.walk.completed){ans.walkIntro=true;ans.walk=true;}
      if(a.checks!=null&&a.tech!=null)ans.checks=true;
      if(a.gender!=null&&a.age!=null&&a.country!=null&&a.education!=null&&a.occupation!=null&&a.serious!=null&&a.data_use!=null)ans.about=true;}
    next();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

config.description: Faithful replication of Study 2 of Menzel, von der Heiden, Tretau & Wissel (2024), Global Environmental Psychology, with the authors' three forest-walk videos from OSF vkp85. Each participant is randomly assigned to one 4.6-minute virtual forest walk: no waste, biowaste, or plastic waste along the path. Before and after the walk they rate state connectedness to nature (13 items) and PANAS (20 items); after it they answer the Restoration Outcome Scale (6 items, 1–7), scene preference (3 items), a description of the video, a litter manipulation check, plastic problem awareness (with an attention item), purchase intentions, policy support, video checks and demographics. Analysis as in the paper: one-way ANOVAs across the three conditions on restoration, pre–post change in positive affect, negative affect and connectedness, the three preference items, problem awareness, intentions and policy support.

paper.title: Wasting the restorative potential: Influences of plastic and biowaste on psychological restoration after real, virtual, and imagined walks
